CPU: pinned X86O3 single thread coupled frontend, plain TAGE speculative direction history
input_policy: same native-validated static ELF and complete official MiBench small input; cold whole process startup to exit includes libc/I/O
warmup_for_injection: no claims of stationary TAGE state; injection starts after 20% of each program's pristine clean duration, with full actual prefix executed per run
normalizations: M0 once as shared reference; CHARM equal_event rate r and equal_expected_flip r/E[K] separately
arrival_clock: homogeneous Poisson in CPU-cycle coordinate after frozen start tick; map continuous cycles to integer Tick by ceil, retain distinct events at equal tick in input order; event clock independent of retired instructions and extends across predictor holds
event_horizon: four times pristine clean end tick is common model stop; schedule all arrivals to that limit. Earlier normal exit right-censors future events; slow designs receive more events. Reaching stop or wall timeout is explicit failure, never masked
site_mapping: SBU uniform exposed bit; K=2 is bit-weighted core field/natural added word with valid logical anchor. selected_payload is bit-weighted natural selected word. One-bit added word K=2 uses a dispersed second distinct population bit; explicit logical sensitivity, no physical geometry

population_exposure.selected_payload: same 346 payload sites/events across schemes, extra cells excluded for targeted comparison
population_exposure.paired_base_full: same 65370 core sites/events across schemes; extra cells excluded here
population_exposure.storage_scaled_full: all core+actual scheme extras incl CPU recovery_active flag, rate r*B_scheme/65370 at equal reference per-bit density; common seeds but changed schedules/sites

latency_contract: read/check at C-cycle completion; corrected storage writeback begins at detection; each repair batch from any origin serializes R response-port cycles; independent backend update lane continues; pending instruction/response withheld and canceled on squash. Consumption/history RMW checks assumed no added clean cycles. Assumption, NOT measured RTL timing
pilot_policy: 3 programs x4 zero =12; two programs x two fields x4 single =16; two programs x3 K profiles x4 selected-repeat =24. Fixed engineering pilot, no outcome-based main sample extension
seed_rule: base+program_index*1000000+field_index*10000+trial; time/K/location streams seeds s,s+1,s+2. Predictor RNG 548 remains independent
main_ideal_run_count: 12 zero clean +480 selected-field single SBU +3600 repeated runs (3 programs*5 model/normalization profiles*2 rates*3 populations*10 seeds*4 schemes)
latency_run_count: 27 protected clean (3 programs*3 schemes*3 check delays, R=4; no duplicate clean R conditions) +120 ideal four-scheme matched-seed references +540 protected faulty (3 programs*3 schemes*3 C*2 R*10 seeds)
resource_authority: user no core/RAM/time limits; bounded concurrency after measured pilot; exclusive per-run output directories
statistical_unit: matched trial seed within each of 3 fixed programs; equal-program mean; preserve helpful/zero effects. No branch-level bootstrap or claim of unseen workload population
explicit_radiation_exclusions: in-flight epoch/fallback copies and existing BranchInfo/CPU checkpoint/queues
pending instruction/response and absolute simulator timing tags
BTB/RAS/architectural state, allocator/aging metadata, shared combinational SET
rate_status: declared software stress rates per cycle, not target per-bit/second calibration or mission FIT
E4_PPA: deferred; actual latency/energy/area not measured; actual measured latency must replace assumptions after interface equivalence
